label: Slack App Messages (all workspaces)
description: Fires an execution for messages in EVERY workspace that installed your Slack app. For app owners distributing their app as a product: each install's events are yours. Needs a connection through your own app with its app-level (xapp-...) Socket Mode token pasted; weft dials out and holds the line, so no public address is needed. For 'a bot in my own workspace', use Slack Receive Message instead.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: A Slack connection through YOUR OWN app, with the app-level (xapp-...) token pasted on it. Reading messages needs the channels:history scope on the installs.

inputs.name: keyword
inputs.label: Contains
inputs.placeholder: Only fire when the text contains this
inputs.description: Only fire on messages whose text contains this. Leave empty for every message.

inputs.name: includeBots
inputs.label: Include bot messages
inputs.description: Also fire on messages posted by bots (including this app's own). Off by default so a workflow that posts cannot trigger itself.
